package position

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// GetPosition returns one position with resolved relations.
type GetPosition struct {
	Positions       repository.PositionRepository
	PositionTechs   repository.PositionTechRepository
	PositionCourses repository.PositionCourseRepository
}

// Handle returns one position with technologies and courses.
func (uc GetPosition) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int, lang string, onlyActiveCourses bool) (domain.Position, error) {
	position, err := uc.Positions.GetByID(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}

	techs, err := uc.PositionTechs.ListTechs(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}

	courses, err := uc.PositionCourses.ListCourses(ctx, id, lang, onlyActiveCourses)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Position{}, err
	}

	attachRelations(position, techs, courses)
	return *position, nil
}
